earnings_release.text: EX-99.1 2 a3q26earningspressrelease.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 State Street Corporation One Congress Street Boston, MA 02114 NYSE: STT www.statestreet.com October 14, 2026 STATE STREET REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 EPS OF $3.69 See note (a) below for a description of the presentation in this news release RON O’HANLEY CHAIRMAN AND CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER $4.0B TOTAL REVENUE , up 13% “The strength of our third-quarter results demonstrates continued momentum and disciplined execution across our global franchises. We generated record quarterly Servicing and Management fees as well as record FX client volumes, reflecting the strength of our client relationships and the breadth of our capabilities. This performance drove our eleventh consecutive quarter of year-over-year positive operating leverage, excluding notable items, resulting in pre-tax margin expansion to approximately 35%.” O'Hanley continued: “Importantly, we progressed our strategic growth initiatives. In 3Q, we won our first Wealth Services mandate with one of the largest registered investment advisors in the United States. Building on an existing Charles River relationship, this mandate demonstrates One State Street in action, leveraging our shared client base, integrated capabilities, and unified coverage model to deepen relationships, expand our addressable market, and drive future growth.” O'Hanley concluded: “We enter the final quarter of the year with strong momentum, a clear strategy, and confidence in our ability to deliver against our medium-term targets while continuing to create long-term value for shareholders.” 531 BPS TOTAL OPERATING LEVERAGE 34.6% PRE-TAX MARGIN 16.4% ROE 25.1% ROTCE (a) FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS (Table presents summary results, dollars in millions, except per share amounts, or where otherwise noted) 3Q26 2Q26 3Q25 % QoQ % YoY Income statement: Total fee revenue $ 3,140 $ 3,188 $ 2,829 (2) % 11 % Net interest income 864 860 715 — 21 Other income — — 1 nm nm Total revenue 4,004 4,048 3,545 (1) 13 Provision for credit losses (4) — 9 nm nm Total expenses 2,620 2,659 2,434 (1) 8 Net income 1,090 1,084 861 1 27 Financial ratios and other metrics: Diluted earnings per share (EPS) $ 3.69 $ 3.65 $ 2.78 1 % 33 % Return on average common equity (ROE) 16.4 % 16.7 % 13.4 % (0.3) % pts 3.0 % pts Return on average tangible common equity (ROTCE) (1) 25.1 25.5 20.9 (0.4) % pts 4.2 % pts Pre-tax margin 34.6 34.3 31.1 0.3 % pts 3.5 % pts AUC/A ($ billions) (2) $ 59,173 $ 57,858 $ 51,664 2 % 15 % AUM ($ billions) (2) 6,306 6,278 5,446 — 16 (1) Ex-notables and some other metrics (e.g., ROTCE, or return on average tangible common equity) are non-GAAP presentations; refer to the Addendum included with this news release for a reconciliation, and further explanations, of non-GAAP measures. reference.summary: State Street Corporation provides various financial products and services to institutional investors. It offers custody, accounting, and fund administration services for traditional and alternative assets, as well as multi-asset class investments; recordkeeping, client reporting, and investment book of record, transaction management, loans, cash, derivatives, and collateral services; investor services operations outsourcing; performance, risk, and compliance analytics; financial data management to support institutional investors; foreign exchange, brokerage, and other trading services; securities finance, such as prime services products; and deposit and short-term investment facilities.
